_doc: Auto-mode policy for the embargo-watch agent. THIS FILE IS HOW A HUMAN CONFIGURES THE AGENTS' ACCESS: what they monitor, and what they may do on their own vs. only after a human approves. Edit it, commit it; changes are auditable. See docs/watch-mode.md.

_options.on_new_cve: propose = report + ask a human (default) | auto-triage = also open a room automatically (still bounded by the require_* gates) | off = watch disabled
_options.min_cvss: only surface advisories at or above this CVSS base score when OSV provides one; 0 = surface all
_options.require_human_to_open_room: true = a human must approve before any disclosure room is opened
_options.require_human_to_build: true = embargo-repro must get approval before it builds/runs any repo
